FAQ

Questions about Sri Sri Thakur and Satsang

Short answers to the questions people ask most about Sri Sri Thakur, Satsang and this site.

Questions and answers

Who was Sri Sri Thakur Anukulchandra?

A physician and spiritual teacher, and the founder of Satsang. He was born at Himaitpur in Pabna, now in Bangladesh, on 14 September 1888, and passed away at Deoghar, Jharkhand, on 27 January 1969. Read his life.

Where was Sri Sri Thakur born?

In the village of Himaitpur, in Pabna district, Bengal, which is now in Bangladesh. The Satsang Ashram at Himaitpur still stands there.

What is Satsang?

The community and organisation that grew around Sri Sri Thakur at Himaitpur. It was registered in Pabna in 1925 as a public charitable institution, moved with him to Deoghar in 1946 and was registered again in India in 1951. Its headquarters is Satsang Ashram, Deoghar.

Where is Satsang Ashram, Deoghar?

At Satsang Nagar, Deoghar, Jharkhand 814116, in the south-west of the town, about 6 km from Jasidih Junction railway station. Visitor guide.

What are the Satsang morning and evening prayers?

Each is a sequence of three prayers followed by the Joy Radhe Radhe kirtan, in Hindi, Sanskrit and Bengali. This site has the full words in English letters, Hindi, Bengali, Odia and Assamese. Open the prayers.

What is Ishtabhriti (Istavrity)?

A daily offering made with love to the Ideal before attending to one's own needs, practised as a discipline of devotion. More on Ishtabhriti.

What is Swastyayani?

A set of vows for wellbeing that ties care of one's own health and character to service of the family and community. More on Swastyayani.

What do Jajan and Yajan mean?

Jajan is cultivating oneself through spiritual practice, study and living by one's ideals. Yajan is sharing what one has received with others through conduct and conversation.

What is Satyanusaran?

His first book, written in Bengali in 1910 when he was 22, to guide a devotee. Its English translation, The Pursuit of Truth, first appeared in 1950. About Satyanusaran.

How many books did Sri Sri Thakur write?

About 94: 82 in Bengali and 12 in English, many of them records of his conversations. See the main books.

How do I find a Satsang centre near me?

Open the Global Map and search by town, district or state. It lists 956 Satsang Vihars and centres in 9 countries. Centres by state and country.

Is this website run by Satsang?

No. srisrithakur.com is an independent, non-commercial site made by devotees. It is not affiliated with Satsang, Deoghar, any Satsang Vihar or any official body, and it earns no money.

Can I use the photos on this site?

The photographs on the Photos page were taken before 1958 and are shared for devotional, non-commercial use. Please keep the caption and credit when you share one.

I found a mistake. How do I tell you?

Send it on WhatsApp or by email from the contact page. If you can, include the book, page or photo that shows the correct detail.

Still have a question?

Write to us on WhatsApp or by email from the contact page. For questions about initiation, personal practice or ashram arrangements, please ask at your nearest Satsang Vihar or at Satsang, Deoghar directly.
